title: Payment Methods, Delinquency Letters and Lockouts: TRICARE Premium-Based Plans Billing Terms
content:
The **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans** accept the initial payment and later monthly premiums through different sets of methods, and each tier carries the same delinquency, termination and lockout figures. Day counts are calendar days.

## Payment methods

| Tier | Initial payment methods | Monthly premiums after the initial payment |
|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only | single card payment, check, electronic funds transfer, recurring card | electronic funds transfer, recurring card |
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family | single card payment, check, electronic funds transfer, recurring card | electronic funds transfer, recurring card |
| TRICARE Young Adult Select | single card payment, check, electronic funds transfer, recurring card | electronic funds transfer, recurring card |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only | single card payment, check, electronic funds transfer, recurring card | electronic funds transfer, recurring card |
| TRICARE Young Adult Prime | single card payment, check, electronic funds transfer, recurring card | electronic funds transfer, recurring card |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family | single card payment, check, electronic funds transfer, recurring card | electronic funds transfer, recurring card |

## Delinquency and nonpayment figures

| Tier | Grace period before termination for nonpayment (days after the due date) | Delinquency letter issued on day | Purchase lockout after a nonpayment termination (calendar months) | Enrollment Reinstatement Review filing window (days after the nonpayment termination) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only | 30 | 10 | 12 | 90 |
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family | 30 | 10 | 12 | 90 |
| TRICARE Young Adult Select | 30 | 10 | 12 | 90 |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only | 30 | 10 | 12 | 90 |
| TRICARE Young Adult Prime | 30 | 10 | 12 | 90 |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family | 30 | 10 | 12 | 90 |

"Delinquency letter issued on day 10" means the tenth calendar day after the due date of an unpaid premium.

## Points of judgement

- A check is accepted for the initial payment but is not among the methods for later monthly premiums.
- A single card payment is likewise an initial-payment method only; recurring card and electronic funds transfer serve both.
